title: The Second Season of 'Old Dog, New Tricks' Premieres on Netflix on 1 January
summary: New year, new me. At least, that’s what the coffee mugs say.
body_markdown:
Entertainment


27 October 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


[Watch the premiere date announcement video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VN6HPttV1k&utm_source=chatgpt.com)


[Download the first-look images](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/bbd4b8f4-e24c-451d-8ab1-8546c41de24c?utm_source=chatgpt.com)


Netflix has today announced the premiere date for the second season of


Old Dog, New Tricks


, which will premiere on Netflix


January 1st, 2027


. Produced by


Alea Media


and nominated for Best Comedy at the


2026 International Emmy Awards


, the series returns with


Luis Zahera


(


Wrong Side of the Tracks


,


Unauthorized Living


),


Lucía Caraballo


(


I Don't Like Driving


,


The Trunk


),


Carmen Ruiz


(


Love in Difficult Times


) and


Álvaro Mel


(


A Perfect Story


,


The Lady's Companion


) leading the cast.


Antón (


Luis Zahera


) is on top of the world. At the new Kawanda Urban, he 's won over the clients, his colleagues and even his boss, Mike (


Álvaro Mel


). But everything changes with the arrival of Uxía (


Lucía Caraballo


), his niece, who has just completed a course in ethology, the science of animal behavior.


Forced to share a practice, uncle and niece turn every diagnosis into a battle: while Antón looks for physical ailments, Uxía focuses on emotional issues. Surrounded by dogs, cats and all kinds of furry friends, Antón, Uxía and Mike launch a pet burial service that brings unexpected prosperity to Topomorto. For once, everything seems to be going their way.


But prosperity comes at a price. As newcomers and baffling new trends take over Topomorto, the village Antón once knew is changing fast. And when their good fortune starts to smell fishy, Antón sets out to uncover what's really going on.


The cast also includes


Adrián Viador


(


Unauthorized Living


),


Raquel Nogueira


(


The Asunta Case


,


The New Years


),


Pepo Suevos


(


Gangs of Galicia


) and


Lucía Veiga


(


Gangs of Galicia


), among others.


Created by


Víctor García León


, the series is directed by


Laura M. Campos


and


Manu Gómez


, with scripts written by


Teresa Bellón


,


César Calvillo


and


García León


himself.


Aitor Gabilondo


(


Patria


,


Salvador


),


Jota Aceytuno


(


Urban. La vida es nuestra


) and


Víctor García León


serve as executive producers.


About Alea Media


Alea Media is a creator-led production company founded in 2017 by Aitor Gabilondo. It develops high-quality scripted content rooted in stories that resonate with real life. Over the past nine years, the company has worked with Spain's leading broadcasters and streaming platforms, establishing itself as a key player in Spanish television drama with titles such as


Patria


,


Wrong Side of the Tracks


,


Unauthorized Living


,


I, addict


and


Salvador


. These are joined by


Old Dog, New Tricks


, which was nominated for Best Comedy at the 2026 International Emmy Awards following the success of its first season.
